app_name: ADHD Habit Tracker, To Do List
title: Wonderful, few small issues
body: This is a beautiful and sleek app. I love it for the main reason that its not clunky, doesn’t have too many features and sticks to the main idea of trying to build a habit, with an accountability aspect. One suggestion I have, is if habits could be made with a start date (already existing) but additionally also have an end date, if someone chooses to have an end date? Thank you

app_name: ADHD Habit Tracker, To Do List
title: Great user experience
body:
The interface is very intuitive and user friendly. You don't need to spend much time figuring out how to use it and it's very aesthetic as well. 

Because it's so simple and easy to update, you'd be more likely to go back to it and keep yourself accountable for your habits. I would recommend starting with only a few habits to track at the beginning and only add new ones once you have built a streak. 

I have enjoyed using this app greatly and would highly recommend it.

app_name: ADHD Habit Tracker, To Do List
title: Streamlined design, varied goal view
body:
I love the minimalist and clean interface, which makes the setting up of habits so much easier. Viewing my goals per duration is much easier because of the option to view in multiple formats (hourly, daily and monthly), even for non-premium users.

As for improvements, it would be cool to have some pre-set habits that I can simply select from a list. Else, good work on the app thus far!
